content: Hypothesis fuzzy anchoring (diff-match-patch quote matching): empirical study found 27% of annotations already orphaned, 61% at risk on live pages; known failure class where annotations fail to anchor yet are NOT reported as orphans (silent loss, hypothesis/product-backlog#954). Lesson: multi-selector anchoring degrades to orphan state but silent-fail path must be tested explicitly; quote snapshot at creation time is the last-resort recovery vector.
